title: Way Beyond The Milk
description: Add chaos to Cosmic Horizons: Storms, Oxygen, Improved Worldgen & more!
body:
## **_[Cosmic Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/cosmic-horizons-cosmos/) is absolutely REQUIRED for the addon to work._**

_( ! ) The Nether and the End are glitched and not intended to be entered when playing with this addon ( ! )_

This Addon was first made for my Youtube series to make the mod more entertaining, but now that the datapack is public, I've also been adding stuff that improves the mod for everyone. So if you can't wait for a feature to be added, it's most likely already in this addon.

![Base on Venus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/271f72db8231eb1184b5464070b10a520d08ce65_0.webp)

***
### Main Features:
- **Improved world generation for most planets**
  - Neptune has giant mountains
  - Gas giants aren't solid flat planets
  - Uranus has chunky terrain with cliffs
  - Pluto doesn't generate with red sand
  - Can now land on the Sun (infinite lava world)
- **Simple oxygen system**
  - Wear a helmet to breathe (compatible with any mod)
- **Jetpacks**
  - If you use Create, sneaking while wearing the Copper Diving Boots will send you flying a fe blocks high until they break (be cautious, the durability is invisible!)
- **Storms**
  - Snowstorms on cold planets
    - Ice-themed visuals
    - Hiding under blocks will prevent you from taking damage
    - Wind will push you in one direction
    - Hurts player
  - Sandstorms on hot planets
    - Sand-themed visuals
    - Hiding under blocks will prevent you from taking damage
    - Wind will push you in one direction
    - Hurts player
  - Thunderstorms
    - Dust particles
    - Lightning bolts strike every few seconds
    - Temporary water puddles where lightning bolts strike
  - Small Tornadoes (only on Neptune)
    - Blue tornado particles
    - Send you flying until you find a way out (or until they disappear)
  - Mega Dust Storms (only on J_1900)
    - Dust particles
    - Strong wind pushing you in one direction
  - Earthquakes (only on Mercury)
    - Shakes screen
    - Explosions that create patches of lava and send blocks flying
  - Acid Rains (only on Venus WITH COMMANDS: too destructive)
    - Yellow/green rain particles
    - Temporary sulphuric acid puddles
    - Blocks touching the acid rain have a chance of being destroyed
    - Hurts player
- **Simple temperature system**
  - Freeze on the moon during the night
  - Freeze when touching water on Europa (unless wearing full armor)
  - Burn on Mercury
- **Survival friendly tweaks**
  - Crafting recipes added for the most important items such as the space nodule
- **Additional stuff**
  - Climbing the mountains of Neptune will give negative effects the higher you are, such as mining fatigue, slowness, freezing (being frozen will hurt the player)
  - Gaia's Blackhole _should_ pull you inside it if you're close enough: still in development
